titulo: Before the room number is printed
subtitulo: Ask for quiet, height and late checkout before the key; name the defect and escalate only if it remains
frasePiso: You can improve the stay before accepting the key and turn a broken room feature into a timed repair or a different room.

steps.pt: Recall B04. Before flying, you made the reservation portable. At reception, open that same booking with the name attached; then improve the room before its number is printed.

steps.promptPt: The receptionist looks up from the screen. State that you have a reservation under the name Morgan. Speak now.
steps.es: Tengo una reservación a nombre de Morgan.
steps.pinyin: TEN-goh OO-nah reh-sehr-bah-SYOHN ah NOHM-breh deh MOR-gahn
steps.pt: I have a reservation under the name Morgan.
Of course. May I see your identification?
The room is not assigned yet. Ask for the outcome that matters, not a magic room number: una habitación más silenciosa.
Is there a quieter room?

steps.promptPt: Before the key is issued, ask whether a quieter room is available. Speak now.
steps.pt: Is there a quieter room?

steps.es: Sí, tengo una lejos del elevador.
steps.pt: Yes, I have one far from the elevator.
steps.tts: Sí, tengo una lejos del elevador.

steps.pt: Quiet has been answered. If height matters too, ask separately so the receptionist can tell you what is actually available.

steps.es: ¿Tiene una habitación en un piso alto?
steps.pinyin: TYEH-neh OO-nah ah-bee-tah-SYOHN en oon PEE-soh AHL-toh
steps.pt: Do you have a room on a high floor?
steps.tts: ¿Tiene una habitación en un piso alto?

steps.promptPt: The quiet room is available. Ask whether it can also be on a high floor. Speak now.
steps.es: ¿Tiene una habitación en un piso alto?
steps.pinyin: TYEH-neh OO-nah ah-bee-tah-SYOHN en oon PEE-soh AHL-toh
steps.pt: Do you have a room on a high floor?
Yes, on the sixth floor.
Now ask the time-sensitive extra before the final morning. Late checkout is availability and policy, not an entitlement; the answer may include a limit or charge.

steps.pinyin: ehs poh-SEE-bleh sah-LEER mahs TAR-deh mah-NYAH-nah
steps.pt: Is it possible to check out later tomorrow?

steps.promptPt: Your flight leaves late tomorrow. Ask whether a later checkout is possible. Speak now.
steps.pinyin: ehs poh-SEE-bleh sah-LEER mahs TAR-deh mah-NYAH-nah
steps.pt: Is it possible to check out later tomorrow?

steps.es: Sí, hasta las dos, con un cargo adicional.
steps.pt: Yes, until two, with an additional charge.
steps.tts: Sí, hasta las dos, con un cargo adicional.

steps.pt: How much is the additional charge?

steps.promptPt: Late checkout is available with an extra charge. Ask its cost before accepting. Speak now.
steps.pt: How much is the additional charge?
Upstairs, the room is quiet but the air conditioner does not start. Name the object and the observable failure. One clean sentence gets maintenance moving.
The air conditioning does not work.

steps.promptPt: The room is quiet, but the air conditioner will not start. Report the observable failure. Speak now.
steps.pt: The air conditioning does not work.
I’ll send maintenance.
A promise without a time leaves you waiting. Ask when someone can check it. You are not demanding a universal service time; you are turning this repair into a checkpoint.
What time can they check it?

steps.promptPt: Reception will send maintenance. Ask when they can check the unit. Speak now.
steps.pt: What time can they check it?
In twenty minutes.

The checkpoint passes and the unit still does not work. Now escalate one level: state that the failure continues and ask for another room. The request is earned by the unresolved scene, not opened as a threat.

steps.es: Sigue sin funcionar. Necesito otra habitación, por favor.
steps.pinyin: SEE-geh seen foon-syoh-NAHR neh-seh-SEE-toh OH-trah ah-bee-tah-SYOHN por fah-BOR
steps.pt: It still doesn’t work. I need another room, please.
steps.tts: Sigue sin funcionar. Necesito otra habitación, por favor.

steps.promptPt: Maintenance checked the unit, but it still does not work. State that and ask for another room. Speak now.
steps.es: Sigue sin funcionar. Necesito otra habitación, por favor.
steps.pinyin: SEE-geh seen foon-syoh-NAHR neh-seh-SEE-toh OH-trah ah-bee-tah-SYOHN por fah-BOR
steps.pt: It still doesn’t work. I need another room, please.

steps.es: Entiendo. Le voy a cambiar la habitación.
steps.pt: I understand. I’ll change your room.
steps.tts: Entiendo. Le voy a cambiar la habitación.

steps.es: ¿Hay una habitación más silenciosa? ¿Es posible salir más tarde mañana? El aire acondicionado no funciona. Necesito otra habitación, por favor.
steps.pinyin: eye OO-nah ah-bee-tah-SYOHN mahs see-len-SYOH-sah. ehs poh-SEE-bleh sah-LEER mahs TAR-deh mah-NYAH-nah. el EYE-reh ah-kohn-dee-syoh-NAH-doh noh foon-SYOH-nah. neh-seh-SEE-toh OH-trah ah-bee-tah-SYOHN por fah-BOR
steps.pt: Shadow improvement, late checkout, defect and escalation.
steps.tts: ¿Hay una habitación más silenciosa? ¿Es posible salir más tarde mañana? El aire acondicionado no funciona. Necesito otra habitación, por favor.

steps.pt: B16 complete. Reservation opened. Quiet and high floor requested before assignment. Late checkout and its charge checked. Defect named without drama. Repair given a time. Another room requested only after the checkpoint failed. You improved first and repaired second.

aprofundar.titulo: Preference before key, evidence before escalation

secoes.titulo: Availability is a return, not a promise
secoes.corpo: Quiet room, high floor and late checkout are requests the hotel answers from current availability and policy. The course never universalises them.
Separating quiet, floor and departure time lets reception give a usable answer instead of guessing which condition matters most.
El aire acondicionado no funciona is stronger than a long story: the object and failure are inspectable. A checkpoint then makes the response measurable.
Otra habitación comes after maintenance and time, not as the opening move. This keeps the exchange calm without trapping the traveller in an unresolved room.
